title: Beyond the Last Stone
description: The invitation is to think carefully without pretending the path is complete.

readerInvitation.reasonToExist: Beyond the Last Stone gives philosophical questions a prehistoric setting. Its people need food while deciding which explanations deserve trust. This imagined novel uses deliberately simple language for demanding ideas.
